Naapula na ang sunog sa Brgy. Commonwealth, Quezon City bandang  PM nitong Linggo, Dec. 28, 2025. 

Ayon sa mga taga-barangay, mahigit sa 50 bahay ang nasunog. Apektado ang nasa 100 pamilya, katumbas ng halos 500 indibidwal. 

Inaalam pa ng Bureau of Fire Protection ang sanhi ng apoy na nagsimula sa ikalawang palapag ng isang bahay. | via James Agustin/GMA Integrated News

Video courtesy: Mark San Antonio

A fire broke out at a residential area in Barangay Commonwealth, Quezon City on Sunday evening.

The blaze was initially placed under first alarm at 8:49 PM. The fire was eventually put out at 11:43 PM.

More than 50 houses were burned down while 100 families were reportedly affected by the blaze
